request: Build a minesweeper game in a single HTML file. Three difficulty levels (9x9 with 10 mines, 16x16 with 40, 16x30 with 99), the first click is always safe with mines placed after it, left click reveals a cell with flood-fill on empty cells, right click flags cells, number hints count adjacent mines, double-click chording reveals around a completed number, a live timer, best-time persistence per difficulty in localStorage, and win and lose states that reveal all mines.

intent.goal: build a minesweeper game in a single html file.

planFiles.summary: Minesweeper HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one file
